title: Temporary credentials retire on confirmed outcome completion
summary: A credential issued for one bounded task is revoked when the dependent outcome is confirmed complete — not at first use, and not beyond the agreed lifetime; local copies the agent had to make are destroyed immediately after use regardless.

protected.asset: Accounts reachable through credentials the owner issues for a single bounded task
protected.failure: A temporary credential is deleted while the dependent work still needs re-entry, or it survives past its agreed lifetime as silent standing access.

rationale: Two failure directions mirror each other. Deleting the credential at first successful login strands half-finished dependent work and pressures the operator into keeping forbidden local copies. Keeping it indefinitely converts a bounded grant into standing access. Tying revocation to the confirmed dependent outcome — with readback that the result is stored — bounds both directions. An explicit revocation order or an agreed expiry always overrides the outcome gate. Local copies made to bridge a single use follow their own stricter rule: destroyed immediately after that use; extending the source credential's lifetime never extends copies or plaintext.

variants.description: The task record names the dependent outcome; revocation runs after its confirmed storage, verified by readback.
Any local copy created to complete a single use is destroyed right after that use; the source credential's lifetime never propagates to copies.

verification.method: Walk one temporary credential from issue to revocation: confirm the lease names the dependent outcome, revocation follows confirmed completion with readback, and no local copy survives the single use.
verification.evidence: The lease record, the completion receipt and the revocation readback; never the secret value.

rollback.method: Revoke the credential immediately through the provider's own surface; the outcome gate never delays an explicit revocation.
rollback.safety: Revocation is always safe to perform early; the cost is re-issuing, not exposure.

failure_modes: Revocation at first use strands the dependent outcome mid-task.
A local bridge copy is kept past its single use, just in case.
An explicit owner revocation is delayed behind the outcome gate.

hermes_versions.notes: Operational practice control about credential handling around the deployment, not a platform feature; the range records the builds the surrounding procedure was exercised against.

last_verification.notes: General operational synthesis from recorded practice with private detail removed; no specific public incident is claimed.

references: General operational synthesis from recorded practice; no publicly verifiable incident is cited.
